text_block_list.text:
Wow! What's everyone laughing at? Did
something funny happen?!
Tell me!
text_block_list.name: Хару Урара

text_block_list.text:
Nothing really happened in particular...
But, you know how both El
and Opera O
performed a solo during the concert?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Well, they started a debate over who
should be considered the star
of the show,
and then Кинг Хало and our class
representative got
involved...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: And this is... how it ended?
text_block_list.name: Райс Шоуэр

text_block_list.text:
...Status—"Perplexed". No connection can
be found between
simultaneous laughter
and the process leading to dispute
resolution.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text:
I agree. They've been at this for about
fifteen minutes already. I
expect that any
moment now they'll realize...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
For us, there's a more fitting way to settle
the score...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. It seems we are left with no other
options.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's time our legs do the
talkin'!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Let's settle this in a race!
text_block_list.name: Everyone

text_block_list.text: Heh, everyone's so full of energy.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
